summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Maris Tech Ltd., a foreign private issuer, providing notice of an annual and special general meeting of shareholders scheduled for August 17, 2026. The agenda includes standard proposals: reappointment of independent auditor, re-election of Class II directors, approval of bonuses and equity-based compensation for the chairman, CEO, and non-executive directors, and presentation of annual financial statements. The board unanimously recommends voting in favor of all items. This is an ordinary proxy solicitation with no special-situation event such as a merger, acquisition, restructuring, or other strategic corporate action.
